See where AI would actually help you

Send a website. What comes back is an honest map of that operation. Where AI would carry real load. Where ordinary software does the same job cheaper and safer. Where it has no business at all. Plus what operators in the same line of work have already published about trying it.

  • Every line traces to a page on your own site, linked so you can check it.
  • The parts that say you don't need AI yet are the honest ones, and they are the point.
  • One report to one address. No list, no follow-up sequence, no second email.
  • It reads what is public. It can't see a billing system or a call volume, and it says so where that matters.

A person reads every report before it goes out, so this takes a day or two rather than ninety seconds. Your report is not published anywhere and is not shown to anyone else.
